figurative_meaning_en: to gnash one's teeth in anger
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাগে সে দাঁত বার করে উঠল।
বিপক্ষের কথায় দাঁত বার করলাম না।
example_sentences_in_english: He bared his teeth in rage.
I didn't gnash my teeth at the opponent's words.
note: This idiom evokes animalistic expressions of fury, common in everyday Bengali speech.
